cases.message:
Here are the main data areas found in the local IPEDS files:

**Survey: Student Financial Aid**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Average net price after grant aid.** Average net price for full-time, first-time degree or certificate-seeking undergraduates, for those awarded grants or federal aid, with some income-level groups. Public institutions cover in-state or in-district payers.
- **Aid types and dollar amounts.** Counts of first-time full-time and all undergraduates receiving grants and loans, with total and average aid dollars. Aid types reported differ by group and year.

**Survey: Cost**

Reporting periods: Academic year 2024-25.

- **Total cost of attendance by residency.** Derived total cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates, by residency and housing plan. Applies to institutions that charge by academic year.
- **Published charges, fees, food and housing.** Published charges: application fees, tuition and required fees, and food and housing, for undergraduate and graduate students. Cost estimates feed the average net price calculation.

**Survey: Institutional Characteristics**

Reporting periods vary by data area; exact coverage is in Definitions & sources.

- **Programs, admissions and services context.** Background on program and award offerings, control, affiliation and special learning opportunities. Includes veterans' support service items. Not a price measure.
- **Branch campus locations and costs.** Branch campus locations listed on College Navigator, with addresses and cost of attendance for branches enrolling first-time full-time undergraduates. Not a complete list.
- **Derived cost of attendance and tuition.** Derived total cost of attendance for full-time, first-time degree-seeking undergraduates by residency and housing plan, plus published tuition and fees by year, for academic-year reporters.

**Survey: Finance**

Reporting periods: Fiscal year 2015 through Fiscal year 2024.

- **Institution finances for nonprofit and FASB schools.** Institution-level revenues, expenditures, assets and liabilities for private not-for-profit and some public FASB institutions. Gives context on costs of education, not family payments.

This is a bounded search of the local IPEDS files, not a complete inventory. Populations, coverage and definitions vary by measure and year; availability does not guarantee reported values for every institution. Some matched records come from a provisional release; see source details. Your wording can have more than one meaning; these data areas are not treated as equivalent.

Tell me the institution, measure and years you would like to explore.
